add_concat_no_carry.hint: You added each column right, but forgot to carry the ten.

no_carry.hint: You carried, but then dropped it before adding it in.

add_carry_wrong_column.hint: That carry belongs in the tens place, not the ones.

add_off_by_one.hint: So close! Recount that last step carefully.

add_used_subtraction.hint: Check the sign: this problem needs addition, not subtraction.

reversed_operands.hint: Subtract the bottom number from the top, not backward.

no_borrow_smaller_from_larger.hint: When a digit is smaller, borrow instead of just subtracting backward.

off_by_ten_in_borrow.hint: You borrowed, but the tens digit still needs to shrink.

sub_zero_minus_n.hint: Zero minus a number isn't that number; borrow first instead.

sub_borrow_across_zero.hint: Borrowing past a zero? Keep going to the next column.

digit_reversal.hint: Right digits, wrong order: check which one comes first.

place_value_confusion.hint: Check your place values; a digit landed in the wrong spot.

unclassified.hint: Let's redo this one column at a time, starting with the ones.
